# Pull request checklist

## Purpose
[Why is this change needed?]

## Scope
[Notebook cells, data path, docs, diagrams, workflow.]

## Research integrity
- [ ] Target and prediction time remain explicit
- [ ] Feature timing and leakage reviewed
- [ ] Missing-value handling documented
- [ ] Split, seeds, and metrics recorded
- [ ] Limitations and uncertainty stated

## Privacy and data rights
- [ ] No patient-level records in diff or outputs
- [ ] No secrets or private identifiers
- [ ] Provenance and attribution preserved
- [ ] Dataset terms respected

## Quality
- [ ] Relevant docs updated
- [ ] Links and assets checked
- [ ] Automated checks run or limitations stated
- [ ] Notebook execution status stated honestly

## Medical safety
- [ ] No diagnostic or treatment claim
- [ ] README safety statement remains prominent
- [ ] No implication of clinical validation
